value.rationale: The selected family is the canonical reflected convex-hull interpolation of a highly symmetric noncentrally symmetric five-dimensional projector body, directly probing its Minkowski asymmetry. The theorem gives the exact entire width response, identifies a sharp invisible interval and a non-obvious cubic transition with exact constant, and distinguishes a smooth-but-not-C3 geometric boundary not supplied by generic integral calculus. It is a structural finite-dimensional classification rather than a narrow isolated numerical evaluation.
